environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL with the following rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule action override to COUNT, (2) a custom rule 'geo-restrict' that blocks non-US source IPs (action: BLOCK, priority 1), (3) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet in default BLOCK mode (priority 2), (4) a custom rate-limit rule at 100 requests per 5 minutes per IP (priority 3). The ECS task role has no S3 or network egress permissions. The container runs with a read-only root filesystem and the SQLite DB is mounted on an EFS volume with encryption at rest enabled via KMS key with a key policy restricting decrypt to the task execution role ARN only.

ecs_task.egress: restricted to VPC endpoints only (no internet)
ecs_task.task_role_permissions: efs:ClientMount, efs:ClientWrite on specific EFS AP

efs_volume.kms_key_policy: decrypt restricted to task execution role ARN
